guidance: Ironclad A0 floor3 MAP, 65/80 HP, 127 gold, one Explosive Ampoule (a same-kind reward refilled the used one), and starter deck plus Impervious, Molten Fist, Dismantle. The sole legal node is Unknown. For event options, avoid a large immediate HP payment or curse unless the concrete reward materially improves the next fights; a small cost for strong damage/relic can be worthwhile at this HP. If the node becomes combat, use current intents and preserve life; the controller excludes proven dominated basic-card end turns. Bash applies Vulnerable, Dismantle attacks twice only against Vulnerable, and Molten Fist doubles Vulnerable then exhausts: sequence these only when the live hand/energy actually permits. Impervious is a one-turn emergency block. Spend the Ampoule when it secures a kill or prevents substantial future damage, not merely because it is available. For card rewards, prefer efficient attack, reliable block or draw; skip weak additions. Recheck legal choices and exact indices every action. Stop at next MAP.
